question: Where can I get rural land prices or rural land transactions in Spain, by municipality or region and year?

answer.summary: Official prices exist, but not per municipality. Best: MAPA 'Precios Medios Anuales de las Tierras de Uso Agrario' (EUR/ha, 18 crop groups; regions and provinces 2020-2024 in xlsx; 2025 provisional exists but was not opened). Municipality level: Catastro IAMIR 2026 gives EUR/ha per crop group for areas (ATH) that group municipalities. Transaction counts by province and month: INE ETDP. Per-deal prices are not public.
main_caveats: MAPA series breaks in 2024: source moved to Catastro notarial sales and base 2020; values before 2020 (base 2016, survey) are not comparable with 2020 onward.
Regional surveys differ: Andalucia 2022 survey 19,934 EUR/ha vs MAPA base-2020 Andalucia 2022 15,748; Catalonia 2024 survey 13,905 vs MAPA 13,030.
IAMIR 2026 uses sales 2023-04-01 to 2026-03-31, excludes built, mixed-crop and flagged sales, and omits Navarra and Pais Vasco; ATH modules are central values per area, not municipal prices.

MAPA values are empty or '..' when not significant; Navarra and Pais Vasco come from regional sources, not Catastro; no Navarra or Pais Vasco land price publication found in Nastat, Eustat or Navarra's foral cadastre.
www.mapa.gob.es fails TLS here; MAPA files read from Internet Archive. 2025 provisional exists (national 10,367 EUR/ha per a news site) but its official PDF was not opened.
answer.confidence_reason: Main sources opened and tested; MAPA live site and 2025 PDF unreachable, 2024 provinces read from a provisional xlsx; IAMIR parsed by text extraction.

Cuadro 1: GALICIA 2020 17535.47, 2023 18554.48. 2024 PDF Cuadro 1: Andalucia 17.064, Total Nacional 10.248. 2024 provisional xlsx, Cuadro 20: Albacete TAS 4929.03; Alava TAR 18331.23; 2025 not available in tables.
steps: Open the MAPA page and take the xlsx for 2020-2023 (provincial tables) and the PDF for 2024 (regional tables).
In the xlsx use sheets Cuadro 22-25 (one per year) for provinces and Cuadro 1-19 for CCAA by crop.
Empty cells mean no significant price; do not read them as zero.
For 2024 provinces use the provisional xlsx (Cuadro 20, August 2025) or the definitive PDF maps (images, February 2026); the definitive xlsx path on the MAPA page is not in the archive.
reading_traps: Series break: MAPA 2024 changed to Catastro data and base 2020; older base-2016 files (2016-2023 survey) are not comparable.
Province names mix cases and accents (Alava, BALEARES, LA RIOJA, NAVARRA, Coruna (La)); single-province regions appear under the region name.
Sheet 'Cuadro 1 ' has a trailing space.
Cuadro 26 counts are three-year windows per reference year (2023 total 229,293), not sales of that year (70,727 in 2024).
2024 provincial prices are map images in the definitive PDF; the text version is the provisional xlsx (August 2025), whose values may differ from the definitive ones (not compared).
Canarias 148,415 EUR/ha in 2024 reflects banana land; per-crop values are not additive.

problems: www.mapa.gob.es certificate chain (FNMT root) was not accepted by curl or WebFetch here; files were read from Internet Archive copies (page 2026-07-17, xlsx 2020-2023 and 2024 provisional, PDF 2024 definitive). The 2024 definitive xlsx and the 2025 provisional PDFs have no archive copy (CDX search) and were not opened.

how_to_use.example_result: Anexo IV rows 'ATH AC MV(EUR/ha) sales': '101 OLS 6.155 115', '102 TAS 4.052 951'. Anexo I.C row: '0101 ANDEVALO Y SIERRA DE ARACENA 21 001 ALAJAR'. PDF is 119.7 MB, 1448 pages, 232 ATH stated.
steps: Get the PDF from the sede page for the exercise wanted (SECAccvr.aspx lists 2022-2027).
Extract text with pdftotext -layout; locate each 'ANEXO I.C' and 'ANEXO IV' block (one per regional report).
Parse Anexo IV lines with regex ^\s*(\d{3,4})\s+([A-Z]{3})\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)$ (about 1,211 rows, 219 ATH).
Join with Anexo I.C on the ATH code padded to four digits (checked for 0101 = 101 only) to give each municipality its module values.
For the map use the viewer Cartografia/mapa.aspx?ZR=SI&anyoZV=2027&buscar=S&final=IAMIR.
reading_traps: Exercise label vs report title: the sede shows 'ejercicio 2027' for the report titled IAMIR 2026.
ATH codes lose the leading zero in Annex IV and II.A (101) but not in Annex I.C (0101); region mapping for codes other than 0101 was not verified.
Numbers use dots as thousands separators (6.155 = 6155 EUR/ha).
A missing ATH-AC pair means no representative product, not zero.
The module is a central value over three years of sales, not a municipality price.

problems: PDF is huge (119.7 MB) and mixes 15 regional reports; no machine-readable table is published.

evidence.quote: se han analizado las compraventas del periodo comprendido entre el 01/04/2023 y el 31/03/2026 comunicadas a Catastro por fedatarios públicos de inmuebles rústicos.
